n1c8aa49dd7d.s: If MGNREGA work is not provided within 15 days of application, the unemployment allowance for the first 30 days is at least:
n1c8aa49dd7d.x: The allowance is at least one-fourth of the wage for the first 30 days and one-half thereafter.

n375a878aa39.s: The administrative cost ceiling under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 is:
n375a878aa39.x: The ceiling was 6% under MGNREGA and is raised to 9% under the VB-G RAM G Act.

nindian-society-1-52.s:
Consider the following statements about welfare milestones in India:
1. MGNREGA, 2005 was India's first rights-based welfare legislation.
2. The IRDP pilot began in 1976.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
nindian-society-1-52.x: Both are true: MGNREGA, 2005 was the first rights-based welfare law, and the IRDP pilot began in 1976.

n602f5f9bb6a.s:
Consider the following statements about the Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY):
1. It was launched on 1 April 1999.
2. It merged six programmes, including IRDP, TRYSEM, DWCRA and the Million Wells Scheme.
3. It was later restructured as the Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n602f5f9bb6a.x: SGSY (1 April 1999) merged six earlier programmes; it was later restructured as NRLM, not as RLEGP.

n59861b3fa02.s: To be eligible under the Health Insurance Scheme for weavers, a weaver must earn at least what share of income from handloom work?
n59861b3fa02.x: Eligibility needs at least 50% of income from handloom work; there is no age cap.

new.s: The first Food for Work Programme was launched in:
new.x: The Food for Work Programme was started in 1977 by the Janata government.

new.s: The National Food for Work Programme (14 November 2004) was launched in how many most backward districts?
new.x: NFFWP covered the 150 most backward districts; 200 was the NREGA launch figure.

new.s:
Arrange in chronological order:
1. SGRY
2. JRY
3. IRDP
4. EAS
The Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY) of September 2001 replaced:
new.x: SGRY replaced JGSY and EAS; NREP and RLEGP had merged into JRY.

new.s: NREGA was launched on 2 February 2006 in how many districts?
new.x: NREGA began in 200 backward districts; 625 is the all-district coverage of 2008.

new.s: The idea of a national rural employment guarantee law was first proposed in 1991 by:
new.x: The rural employment guarantee was first proposed in 1991 by P.V. Narasimha Rao.

new.s: Which report described MGNREGA as a 'stellar example of rural development'?
new.x: The World Bank's World Development Report 2014 called MGNREGA a stellar example of rural development.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about MGNREGA:
1. Water conservation and land development are permissible works.
2. Women must form at least one-half of the beneficiaries.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Water conservation and land development are permissible works; the women quota is at least one-third, not one-half.

new.s: Through MGNREGA convergence, PMAY-G house beneficiaries get how many person-days of work?
new.x: Convergence gives 90/95 person-days to PMAY-G beneficiaries through the AwaasSoft-NREGASoft link.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025?
o: It was passed by Parliament on 18 December 2025
It guarantees 125 days of work per household
Job cards are replaced by Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Cards
new.x: The administrative ceiling is 9% under VB-G RAM G; 6% was the MGNREGA ceiling.

new.s: The general Centre-State funding ratio under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 is:
new.x: Funding is 60:40, with 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States and UTs.

new.s: The wage floor fixed under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 is:
new.x: VB-G RAM G fixes a wage floor of ₹300 a day, paid weekly or within a fortnight; ₹700 was a union demand.

new.s: PM-SVANidhi, which gives collateral-free loans to street vendors, is a scheme of the Ministry of:
new.x: PM-SVANidhi is run by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, not MSME.

new.s: PM Vishwakarma supports how many traditional artisan trades?
new.x: PM Vishwakarma (MSME) covers 18 traditional artisan trades with training, toolkits and credit.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan – Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
PM Vishwakarma – Ministry of Rural Development
National Career Service – Ministry of Labour and Employment
new.x: National Career Service (2015) is a Labour and Employment portal; DDU-GKY and Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan are Rural Development, PM Vishwakarma is MSME.

new.s: Under PMEGP, the maximum project cost for a manufacturing unit is now:
new.x: The PMEGP cap is ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for service units (earlier ₹25 lakh / ₹10 lakh).

new.s: The Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan (2020) was a 125-day campaign for:
new.x: It was a 125-day Rural Development campaign for returnee migrants in 116 districts of 6 States.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, average MGNREGA days per household fell from 51.62 in 2024-25 to what in 2025-26?
new.x: Average days per household in AP fell from 51.62 to 43.37, with person-days falling from 2,422.84 lakh to 1,859.77 lakh.

new.s: In June 2026, Andhra Pradesh pooled rural development funds to give how many days of work in distressed rural pockets?
new.x: AP pooled funds to provide 125 days of work in distressed rural pockets.

new.s: Which is regarded as India's first poverty alleviation programme?
new.x: The Rural Works Programme of the 1970s is regarded as the first poverty alleviation programme.

new.s: The Community Development Programme, called the 'mother of social development programmes', was launched in:
new.x: The Community Development Programme began on 2 October 1952; the National Extension Service followed in 1953.

new.s: Which is regarded as India's first food security programme?
new.x: The Public Distribution System is regarded as the first food security programme.

new.s: SITRA, one of the programmes merged into SGSY, stands for:
o: Scheme for Integrated Training of Rural Artisans
Self-employment and Industrial Training for Rural Artisans
Supply of Improved Toolkits to Rural Artisans
Supply of Irrigation Tools to Rural Agriculturists
new.x: SITRA (1992) is Supply of Improved Toolkits to Rural Artisans.

new.s: The Ganga Kalyan Yojana (1997) provided:
o: Bore-well and tube-well irrigation for small and marginal farmers
Group support to rural women and children
new.x: Ganga Kalyan Yojana gave bore-well/tube-well irrigation to small and marginal farmers; toolkits were SITRA, training TRYSEM, women DWCRA.

new.s: TRYSEM (Training of Rural Youth for Self Employment) was started on:
new.x: TRYSEM began on 15 August 1979 as an extra part of IRDP.

new.s: The Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme (RLEGP) was launched in:
new.x: RLEGP began in 1983 in the Sixth Plan; it merged with NREP into JRY in 1989.

new.s: NRLM was renamed Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana–NRLM (DAY-NRLM) in:
new.x: NRLM (Aajeevika, launched June 2011) became DAY-NRLM in 2016.

new.s: NRLM fully replaced SGSY from:
new.x: NRLM was launched in June 2011 and fully replaced SGSY from 1 April 2013.

new.s: Which of the following was NOT merged into SGSY in 1999?
new.x: JRY was not part of SGSY; SGSY merged IRDP, TRYSEM, DWCRA, SITRA, Ganga Kalyan Yojana and the Million Wells Scheme.

new.s: Under DAY-NRLM, the poor are identified through:
o: Participatory Identification of Poor, vetted by the Gram Sabha
Annual survey by the State Planning Board
new.x: DAY-NRLM uses Participatory Identification of Poor (PIP), vetted by the Gram Sabha.

new.s: The Lakhpati Didi target under DAY-NRLM is to be reached by March 2029 with:
new.x: 2 crore Lakhpati Didis were crossed by Feb 2026; the target is 6 crore by March 2029.

new.s: DAY-NRLM is implemented by the Ministry of:
new.x: DAY-NRLM is under Rural Development; DAY-NULM is under Housing and Urban Affairs.

new.s: Which of the following DAY-NULM components is correctly matched?
o: SUSV – Support to Urban Self-help Ventures
SUH – Skill Upgradation for Urban Households
PAISA – Programme for Affordable Interest-free Self-employment Assistance
new.x: SM&ID is Social Mobilisation & Institution Development; SUSV is Support to Urban Street Vendors, SUH is Shelter for Urban Homeless.

new.s: The Shelter for Urban Homeless (SUH) component of DAY-NULM provides:
new.x: SUH provides permanent all-weather shelters; vending spaces and credit come under SUSV.

new.s: Rashtriya Mahila Kosh (1993) provides:
o: Micro-credit to poor women in the unorganised sector
Training in traditional and non-traditional trades
Support to women in difficult circumstances
new.x: Rashtriya Mahila Kosh gives micro-credit to poor women; trade training is Swalamban, difficult circumstances Swadhar, integrated empowerment Swayamsiddha.

new.s: Which organisation pioneered SHG-bank linkage in India in the mid-1980s, before the national programme?
new.x: MYRADA pioneered bank linkage in the mid-1980s; NABARD launched the national pilot in 1992.

new.s: STEP, a women's scheme, stands for:
o: Scheme for Training and Empowerment of Poor Women
Support to Training and Employment Programme for Women
Support to Thrift and Enterprise Programme
new.x: STEP is the Support to Training and Employment Programme for Women.

new.s: The Velugu project (2000) in Andhra Pradesh was supported by:
new.x: Velugu was a World Bank District Poverty Initiatives Project; SAPAP (1995) was supported by UNDP.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, Stree Nidhi provides:
o: Pension and insurance to SHG women
Credit to SHG members in rural and urban areas
Support to the poorest SC/ST SHG households
Interest subsidy to rural SHGs only
new.x: Stree Nidhi gives credit to SHG members, rural and urban; pension and insurance is Abhaya Hastham, poorest SC/ST is Unnati.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, 'Vaddi Leni Runalu' for SHGs means:
o: Interest-free loans that reward prompt repayment
new.x: Vaddi Leni Runalu are interest-free loans that reward prompt repayment by SHGs.

new.s: The RuPay accident insurance cover for PMJDY account holders has been raised to:
new.x: The RuPay accident cover was raised from ₹1 lakh to ₹2 lakh.

new.s: As of August 2026, about how many PMJDY accounts had been opened?
new.x: PMJDY had 59.09 crore accounts; 32.92 crore are of women and 45.95 crore are rural.

new.s: In India Stack, the consent layer enables:
new.x: The consent layer (DEPA) allows consent-based data sharing via Account Aggregators, not ATM cash withdrawal.

new.s: The Aadhaar-enabled Payment System (AePS) is used for:
o: Routing DBT payments to bank accounts
new.x: AePS allows cash withdrawal at micro-ATMs; DBT routing is done by APBS.

new.s: In FY 2024-25, Direct Benefit Transfer covered how many schemes?
new.x: In FY 2024-25 DBT transferred ₹6.9 lakh crore under 327 schemes.

new.s: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana was launched on 1 May 2016 at:
new.x: Ujjwala was launched at Ballia (UP); Ranchi was PM Kisan Maan-dhan and Tembhli the first Aadhaar.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about PAHAL:
1. It transfers the LPG subsidy directly into the consumer's account.
2. It was the first application of the JAM trinity.
3. It is run by the Ministry of Rural Development.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: PAHAL is DBT for LPG and the first JAM application; it is under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.

new.s: In the 2018 Puttaswamy (Aadhaar) judgement, which provision of the Aadhaar Act was struck down?
new.x: Section 57 (private use) was struck down; Section 7 (welfare use) was upheld.

new.s: The 2018 Puttaswamy (Aadhaar) verdict was delivered by a bench of:
new.x: Puttaswamy II (2018) was a 5-judge, 4:1 verdict; Puttaswamy I (2017) was a 9-judge bench.

new.s: The annual premium of PMSBY from 1 June 2022 is:
new.x: The PMSBY premium was raised from ₹12 to ₹20 a year on 1 June 2022, the first rise since 2015.

new.s: The age band for enrolment under PMSBY is:
new.x: PMSBY covers 18-70 years; PMJJBY covers 18-50 years.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about PMSBY?
o: It gives ₹1 lakh for partial disability
Its premium was raised on 1 June 2022
new.x: PMSBY covers accidental death and disability and has no suicide cover.

new.s: Atal Pension Yojana assures a monthly pension at 60 of:
new.x: APY gives ₹1,000-5,000 a month at 60; a fixed ₹3,000 is under PM-SYM and PM-KMY.

new.s: The monthly contribution of a farmer under PM Kisan Maan-dhan ranges from:
new.x: Farmers contribute ₹55-200 a month depending on age, and the Centre matches it.

new.s: The entry age for citizens joining the National Pension System is:
new.x: NPS is open to citizens (resident/NRI) and OCIs aged 18-70; 18-40 is the APY and PM-SYM band.

new.s: Under the Annapurna scheme of NSAP, needy elderly not covered by IGNOAPS get how much free foodgrain a month?
new.x: Annapurna gives 10 kg of free foodgrains a month.

new.s: The National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS) under NSAP provides:
o: A monthly pension to BPL widows
A lump sum to a family that loses its breadwinner
new.x: NFBS gives a lump sum to a family losing its breadwinner; widows' pension is IGNWPS and disability pension IGNDPS.

new.s: The EPF & MP Act, 1952 applies to establishments with at least how many employees?
new.x: The EPF & MP Act, 1952 covers establishments with 20 or more employees.

new.s: Under the NTR Bharosa Pension (June 2024), the old-age pension in Andhra Pradesh was raised from ₹3,000 to:
new.x: NTR Bharosa raised the pension from ₹3,000 to ₹4,000; disabled persons get ₹6,000.

new.s: Under YSR Pension Kanuka (2019), pensions in Andhra Pradesh were delivered:
o: At the doorstep by Village/Ward Secretariat staff
new.x: YSR Pension Kanuka introduced doorstep delivery through Village/Ward Secretariat staff.
